dedupe_keys.name: αδειες χρησης νερου πλωτων μοναδων υδατοκαλλιεργειας

description: Άδειες χρήσης νερού πλωτών μονάδων υδατοκαλλιέργειας is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Διεύθυνση Υδάτων. Datasæt for suspenderede afgørelser om tilladelse til anvendelse af vand fra flydende akvakulturenheder samt ændringer og fornyelser heraf. Coverage: Διεύθυνση Υδάτων. The portal shows the English title as "Plaukiojančiųjų akvakultūros vienetų vandens naudojimo licencijos" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Διεύθυνση Υδάτων. Its keywords include Περιβάλλον, Υδατικοί πόροι, Από μετάπτωση, Υδατοκαλλιέργεια, repository.data.gov.gr. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XML, JSON. The listing shows 2026-04-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
